additional_info.subject: ID0460526-DC/Si-D/UK-[Y2/R3 312881977024] OCPP request goes into faulted state CRM:03056000454
additional_info.body:
Hi Jason, good morning.
As we checked yesterday, it seems we have 2 kinds of "problems". First is that the authentication is not provided in due time and fails
Second is that the StateMonitor in the charger provided might not be working properly, or the contactor not closing.
You told me you were doing some tests today so please let me know what you find here.
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0460526-DC/Si-D/UK-[Y2/R3 312881977024] OCPP request goes into faulted state CRM:03056000454
additional_info.body:
Please close this ticket.
The ticket was raised against FOUGCk but affected all chargers at the site:
FOUGCk
97qyz5
k4uITX
12iP4D
4lNNV0
Mutliple problems were found:
12iP4D we found the statemonitor was not correctly reading the voltage at cable check on both outlets – we don’t know why but a reboot fixed it.
4lNNV0 we found a loose cable from the temp sensor on outlet 2 – the cable was reinstalled to the terminal block, and the problem solved
All other chargers showing that authentication of sessions is timing out – back office issue, which has been raised with the OCPP provider
Poor 4G signal strength on both SCB and OCPP teltonikas – we will address this with external antennas
Thanks,
Jason
